jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
At CompucomStaffing
,
you’re more than just a number. Our employee relationship managers support you throughout your engagement, providing career guidance and reemployment assistance.

Our client has a new opportunity for a qualified Field Technician
to join their team. The technician is responsible for supporting the deployment, installation, remediation, refresh, and decommissioning of technology equipment across client retail locations. Technicians will complete a variety of hardware, networking, POS, camera, and infrastructure-related tasks while ensuring all project procedures, documentation, and compliance requirements are followed. This role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, professionalism in a retail environment, and the ability to work independently while coordinating with Deployment Support and store leadership.

This position may support multiple retail and enterprise locations throughout the greater Bay Area market, including San Francisco, Alameda, Antioch, Colma, Daly City, Dublin, Emeryville, Fremont, Hayward, Livermore, Menlo Park area, Redwood City, Richmond, San Bruno, San Francisco, San Jose, San Leandro, San Mateo, San Rafael, San Ramon, Sausalito, Walnut Creek. Additional nearby locations may be assigned based on business needs.

Duties And Responsibilities

Perform onsite installation, remediation, refresh, and removal of technology hardware and infrastructure components
Support projects involving:
POS systems
Hand scanners
Camera upgrades
UPS NIC card refreshes
Network remediation
Control room cleanup
Data port security
WiFi antenna remediation

Install and replace devices including Zebra scanners, cameras, UPS NIC cards, switches, servers, and related cabling
Validate device functionality, connectivity, and operational status after installation
Coordinate with Deployment Support for project validation and issue resolution
Capture and submit required project deliverable photos and documentation
Package and prepare removed equipment for return shipment or disposal
Maintain clean and organized work areas throughout installations
Follow all client safety, security, and code of conduct requirements
Check in and out daily using project tracking systems and communicate project status updates

Technical Responsibilities

Hardware installation and replacement
Basic networking and cabling
POS device support
Peripheral device installation
Equipment decommissioning
Cable management and labeling
Connectivity testing and validation
Inventory verification and equipment staging
Troubleshooting installation and deployment issues

Skills And Qualifications

Experience with IT field services, desktop support, or deployment projects
Basic understanding of:
Networking
POS systems
Cabling and connectivity
Hardware installations

Ability to follow detailed installation instructions and project documentation
Strong communication and customer service skills
Ability to work in active retail environments with minimal disruption
Experience using ticketing systems, deployment tools, or project tracking systems preferred
Ability to lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs. with team assistance when required
Retail deployment experience preferred
POS installation experience preferred
Low-voltage or structured cabling experience preferred
Experience with Zebra, Honeywell, Cisco, or UPS hardware preferred
Experience supporting large-scale rollout projects preferred

Benefits

The Company offers a comprehensive benefit package that you can elect into including but not limited to the following benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, AD&D insurance, disability plans, Employee Assistance Program, paid holidays (up to 6 days annually), paid time off (minimum of 10 days annually), paid parental leave (minimum of 10 days annually), 401(k), FSA/HSA pre-tax benefits.

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

W2 only, no Corp to Corp.

jobs.title: Production Geologist (Lost Creek Mine Site)
jobs.description:
Ur-Energy | Lost Creek, WY | Full-Time | Exempt

About The Role

Ur-Energy is seeking an experienced Production Geologist to support delineation and production drilling programs and resource development at our Lost Creek ISR uranium facility in Wyoming. This is a technically hands-on role working closely with the Geology Manager and cross-functional teams to keep active wellfield operations running efficiently and in compliance.

If you have a strong geology background, ISR or uranium mining experience, and enjoy translating data into actionable field decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Provide geological and technical expertise in support of drilling programs and resource development projects
Assist with geologic logging of drill cuttings, environmental sampling, and related field investigations
Interpret drilling data from geophysical logs and core samples
Perform mineral resource calculations and prepare technical reports for senior staff review
Design monitor and production pattern wells
Create and update maps, figures, and technical exhibits using GIS and CAD software for operational, permitting, and presentation purposes
Prepare and deliver written and oral technical reports, summaries, and recommendations
Coordinate with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) personnel to support permitting, bonding, and regulatory compliance

Required

What We're Looking For

Bachelor of Science in Geology or Geological Engineering
2+ years of geological experience; mining experience preferred
Working knowledge of geophysical logs and related concepts as applied in ISR uranium mining
Understanding of hydrologic concepts as they relate to uranium deposition and extraction
Strong GIS skills and general computer proficiency
Professional-level written and verbal communication skills
Valid driver's license with an insurable driving record

You'll Stand Out If You Have

Direct ISR or uranium mining experience
Familiarity with permitting and regulatory compliance in a mining context
Experience with CAD software in addition to GIS platforms

Work Environment

This is a site-based role at our Lost Creek facility in Sweetwater County, Wyoming. Work includes both office-based tasks and field assignments, with exposure to outdoor weather conditions and varied noise levels. Physical requirements include the ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb, balance, stoop, kneel, and crouch as needed.

Why Ur-Energy

Ur-Energy (NYSE American: URG | TSX: URE) is one of Wyoming's leading uranium producers, operating the Lost Creek ISR facility and the newly active Shirley Basin project. We offer a stable, safety-focused environment where geologists play a meaningful role in active operations from day one.

Competitive salary commensurate with experience
Comprehensive benefits package
Site-based role with real operational responsibility
Growing company with two active Wyoming mine sites

How To Apply

Submit your resume along with a brief summary of your geology experience, particularly any ISR or uranium mining background. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Ur-Energy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Connect for Health has a great opportunity for a Product Data Analyst.

Connect for Health Colorado is a public, non-profit entity established by the Colorado General Assembly in 2011 to create a health insurance Marketplace. Since 2013, we’ve been helping individuals, families, and small employers compare plans, apply for financial help, and buy health insurance. As Colorado’s official health insurance marketplace, we are the only place to apply for financial help to lower the monthly cost of premiums. Customers can shop online; get help by phone or online chat from Customer Service Center representatives; and access expert help from a statewide network of certified Brokers and community-based Assisters. Our mission is to increase access, affordability, and choice for individuals and small employers
purchasing health insurance in Colorado. For more information: ConnectforHealthCO.com

Position Summary

Connect for Health Colorado is seeking a Product Data Analyst to help our product teams make better decisions using trustworthy, meaningful data. This role sits within the Product Analytics & Strategy team, part of Product Operations, which helps product teams integrate data into how they explore problems, plan solutions, and measure success. Our goal is to ensure product teams have easy access to well-defined data and feel confident using it to guide their decisions.

As a Product Data Analyst, you will work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, product operations, and analytics partners to turn product data into clear insights about customer behavior, product performance, and opportunities for improvement. You will focus on hands-on analysis, dashboard development, and measurement of product outcomes, helping product teams understand whether their work is delivering real value for customers.

Position Responsibilities

Help Product Teams Make Data-Informed Decisions

Analyze product usage and customer journey data to identify meaningful patterns and opportunities to improve product outcomes
Partner with product managers to identify key product questions and ensure analysis and reporting support product planning, prioritization, and decision-making
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform product decisions
Contribute analysis that helps teams evaluate trade-offs, risks, and opportunities

Measure Product Performance and Impact

Implement measurement plans for new features, experiments, and product initiatives
Analyze product adoption, engagement, and usage patterns
Help evaluate whether product changes achieve intended customer and business outcomes
Surface opportunities to improve product performance based on data trends

Build Dashboards and Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards that track product health and key performance metrics
Ensure dashboards are clear, intuitive, and aligned with shared metric definition.
Create repeatable reporting that enables teams to independently monitor performance
Partner with stakeholders to ensure reporting supports real decision-making needs

Enable Teams to Use Product Data

Coach product teams through interpreting analytics dashboards and reports
Provide guidance on how to use product analytics tools and metrics effectively
Create documentation and usage guidance that enables self-service reporting
Provide day-to-day support on product data, metrics, dashboards, and analytics tool usage

Promote Reliable and Trustworthy Product Data

Model established standards for product data collection, metrics, and reporting
Help identify and resolve data quality issues
Partner with business intelligence, data engineering, and other data teams when product data needs alignment with enterprise reporting
Contribute to clear documentation of data sources, data definitions, and metrics

Work Across the Product Data Ecosystem

Analyze product data using tools such as Pendo, Power BI, and Snowflake
Analyze and incorporate data from product development tools such as Jira to help teams understand delivery progress and product outcomes.
Collaborate with product, UX research, and business intelligence partners to connect product insights with broader organizational data

Requirements

Colorado resident
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a product, digital, or analytics environment
Experience querying (e.g. SQL) and working with product or behavioral data to generate insight
Experience building dashboards and data visualizations (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
Ability to identify when data or metrics appear inconsistent and investigate root causes
Skill in translating data into insights that inform product and business decisions
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Curiosity and critical thinking

Preferred

Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, analytics, or a related field
Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Pendo, Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
Familiarity with tools and workflows that support the product development lifecycle (e.g. Jira, roadmap tools)
Experience working in an agile or iterative product development environment
Background in product management, business intelligence, or similar

Work Environment

Currently working remotely.
The Connect for Health Colorado office is located in the North Tech Center area of Denver, near the intersection of I-25 and I-225.
Work schedule may include some non-traditional hours, weekends, and evening events.
Core office hours are typically 8 am-5 pm with some flexibility.

Total Compensation

Connect for Health Colorado offers a competitive benefits package. Employees are offered a robust benefits package and may elect from various offerings to tailor a package best suited to their individual needs. Connect for Health Colorado employees are eligible to participate in the organization’s 403(b) plan and are additionally provided with paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance. The salary range for this position is $72,100 - $94,760 per year.

To Apply

Please apply on our Career page at https://connectforhealthco.com/about-us/employment/.

Connect for Health Colorado is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). Connect for Health Colorado may, at its discretion, conduct a background check on any workforce member and/or require job candidates to successfully complete a background check as a condition of employment.

Application Deadline
: This will be posted for a minimum of 30 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. *Post date: 04/14/2026
